intro: Your teacher has asked you to speak in front of the class. Talk about something you like.
vocabulary: I would like to talk about

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: It is your turn to speak. What will you talk about today?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say what your talk is about.
expected: I would like to talk about my favourite book.
Today I will talk about my village.
I want to talk about my family.
conversation.hint: Try: "I would like to talk about my favourite book."

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: A good choice. Tell the class why you chose it.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Explain your reason for choosing it.
expected: I chose it because it is very interesting.
The reason is that I love reading it.
I chose this because it makes me happy.
conversation.hint: Try: "I chose it because it is very interesting."

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: Can you give the class an example?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Give an example to support what you said.
expected: For example, it teaches us to be brave.
For example, I read it every evening.
For example, my brother liked it too.
conversation.hint: Try: "For example, it teaches us to be brave."

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: Very good. How did you feel when you first read it?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Describe how you felt, using the past tense.
expected: I felt very happy when I read it.
I was excited when I first read it.
I felt surprised at the ending.
conversation.hint: Try: "I felt very happy when I read it."

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: That was a lovely talk. Well done.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Finish your talk and thank the class.
expected: In conclusion, I recommend it to everyone. Thank you.
That is all, thank you for listening.
Thank you all for listening to me.
conversation.hint: Try: "That is all, thank you for listening."
